title: VTA Context DID-Template Delete — payload
description: Remove a DID template scoped to a context on a VTA by name. Gated on the context's admin (or super-admin). The success response echoes the name and confirms deletion.

contextId.description: The context the template is scoped to.

name.description: Resource id of the template to remove within the context scope.

Response.title: VTA Context DID-Template Delete — response payload
Response.description: Confirmation that the named context-scoped template was removed.

name.description: The template name that was removed; echoes the request `name`.
